lines: Note: Asset CAGR 2021–2025 ~9.9%. CCB adds ~$2.2B assets + $2.8B trust AUM. FNBO moved from 16th to 9th-largest bank in Kansas City by deposit share. [E-001, E-002, E-003, financial_baseline.json]

Trajectory Classification: ACCELERATING. CCB acquisition (+$2.2B assets, +$2.8B trust AUM) represents a step-change in scale. Revenue CAGR (~13.6%) outpaces asset growth — improving operational leverage from BaaS/embedded finance. [E-001, E-002, E-003, financial_baseline.json]

firmographics.narrative_md: FNBO is a nationally chartered, FDIC-insured bank headquartered at 1601 Dodge Street, Omaha, Nebraska 68197 — a new headquarters as of 2025. Founded in 1857, FNBO is one of the longest-operating privately held banks in the United States, operating as a subsidiary of First National of Nebraska, Inc. (FNNI), a multi-generational family holding company led by Chairman and President Clark Lauritzen.
